verdict.rationale: Datadog's Log Management, Dashboards, and API Reference docs imply ad hoc querying capability (e.g., log search syntax, metric queries), and a community comment confirms hands-on ad hoc field-based querying ('clicking on a field to make it a custom search dimension'). However, the evidence pack lacks a direct citation to a dedicated, documented query language reference (e.g., Log Search Syntax or DQL docs) confirming a formal, well-documented query language. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the query language syntax/reference, independent corroboration of query language completeness, and examples of ad hoc query workflows across telemetry types (logs, metrics, traces).
